title: hYYa Digital Footprint Check
shortDescription: Bona okwaziwa izinhlelo, hlola izimvume ulungise kancane kancane ngasese.
fullDescription:
100% mahhala: azikho izikhangiso, akukho okuthengwayo ngaphakathi kohlelo.

Izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza zingazi okuningi kakhulu ngawe kunalokho okucabangayo. I-hYYa Digital Footprint Check ikukhombisa lokho ezingakubona, lokho okunokufinyelela okukhethekile, nokuthi ungalungisa kanjani, ngamazwi acacile.

IZINYATHELO EZINE EZILULA
1. Footprint: ukuthinta okukodwa kuhlola lokho noma yiluphi uhlelo olungakufunda mayelana nedivayisi yakho.
2. Sensitive apps: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zakho abanye abangazibona, njengezinhlelo zokuthandana, ezokukholwa, ezempilo noma i-VPN, nokuthi lokho kungathini ngawe.
3. Tracker: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingafunda isikrini sakho, zifunde zonke izaziso, noma zikhiye idivayisi yakho. Izinhlelo ezinezimvume ezingaphezu kweyodwa kulezi ziyamakwa, ngoba yilokho izinhlelo zokugada ezikwenzayo. Bese uvula irekhodi le-Android uqobo elikhombisa izinhlelo ezisebenzise indawo yakho, ikhamera kanye nemakrofoni.
4. Check-up: landela izinyathelo ezilula ezifana nezibuyekezo, ukuqalisa kabusha idivayisi masonto onke kanye nokuhlola amaphasiwedi avunyelwe, bese ubuyekeza izilungiselelo zakho endaweni eyodwa ngesikhathi ukuze uhoxise ukufinyelela ongafuni ukukunikeza.

ISIKOLO ESISODWA KUKHO KONKE OKUNE
Isikolo sakho sobumfihlo, ekhulwini (100), sihlanganisa konke okuhloliwe okune. Isikolo esiphezulu singcono, futhi siyakhula njengoba uqeda ukuhlola ngakunye. Faka iwijethi ukuze ubone isikolo sakho nokuhlola kwakho kokugcina ngokushesha.

LUNGISA NAMI
Thinta "Fix them with me" bese uhlelo lokusebenza lukuhola ekulungiseni ngakunye, kancane kancane, lukusiza ukuba uthole isilungiselelo esifanele ngokushesha. Bese uhlola kabusha ubone isikolo sakho sikhuphuka.

KUCACILE, KUNOKUTHULA FUTHI KWETHEMBEKILE
• Ishadi lemibala ekhasini ngalinye: okubomvu kudinga ukubhekwa, okuphuzi kufanele ukwazi, okuluhlaza kulungile.
• Konke okutholiwe ngamazwi alula: isihloko esifushane, umugqa owodwa wokuthi kungani kubalulekile, nokuthi ungalungisa kanjani.
• Izinhlelo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi kwidivayisi yakho azimakwa, kanti izinhlelo zokulawula abazali noma zomsebenzi zibizwa ngalokho eziyikho ngempela.
• Impendulo eqotho ethi "i-Google kuphela noma umenzi wedivayisi ongalungisa lokhu" lapho kungekho ongakwenza.
• Isikhumbuzi samasonto onke noma senyanga sokuhlola futhi, uma ufuna.

IYABONAKALA NOMA NGABE USUSA UHLELO LOKUSEBENZA
I-Android inikeza izinhlelo zenkampani ngayinye ikhodi ehlala ifana noma ngabe uyazisusa bese uzifaka kabusha. Bona eyakho, nokuthi kungani ukusetha kabusha kwasembonini kuphela okuyishintshayo.

UBUMFIHLO NGOKOMKLAMO
• Ayikho imvume ye-inthanethi: uhlelo alukwazi ukuxhuma ndawo, ngakho akukho lutho olushiya idivayisi yakho.
• Ayikho i-akhawunti, azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela.
• Mahhala. Akukho okuthengwayo, akukho okubhaliselwe.
• Umthombo ovulekile, ukuze noma ngubani akwazi ukuhlola ukuthi lusebenza kanjani.

Hlangana nomsizi ongumseshi: ukhona ekhasini ngalinye futhi unethiphu uma umthinta.

I-hYYa Digital Footprint Check iyingxenye yomndeni we-hYYa wezinhlelo zokusebenza ezibeka ubumfihlo phambili.
releaseNotes: Lokhu kukhishwa kuqukethe ukulungiswa kweziphazamisi okuvamile nokuthuthukiswa kokuzinza.
